            )
        )

        "androidx.fragment.app.Fragment",

                ISSUE,
                declaration as UElement,
                context.getNameLocation(declaration as UElement),
                "This fragment inner class should be static so it can be re-instantiated by the system"
            )
        }

        if (isAndroidX) {
            return
        }

        val constructors = declaration.constructors
        if (constructors.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        val noArgConstructors = constructors.filter { it.parameterList.parameters.isEmpty() }
        if (noArgConstructors.isEmpty()) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                declaration as UElement,
                context.getNameLocation(declaration as UElement),
                "This fragment should provide a no-arg constructor so it can be re-instantiated by the system"
            )
        } else if (noArgConstructors.none { it.hasModifierProperty(PsiModifier.PUBLIC) }) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                declaration as UElement,
                context.getNameLocation(declaration as UElement),
                "This fragment's no-arg constructor must be public so it can be re-instantiated by the system"
            )
        }

                    ISSUE,
                    constructor,
                    context.getNameLocation(constructor),
                    "Avoid passing arguments to fragment constructors; use `setArguments(Bundle)` instead"
                )
            }
        }
    }
